title: A caretaker pass frees a held account that answers, reports, and Home shows what needs the owner
description: Seed a held account whose live request passes and a compute host that is away, run one loop cycle whose caretaker pass is a stub agent following the checklist with the caretaker's own token, and assert the account becomes available, the report is saved, Home shows the away host's line under Needs you, and a requirements call with the caretaker's token answers 403.

steps.name: one caretaker pass reports and Home shows its needs-the-owner line
